sources.title: United Nations Office at Geneva: Multi-what?
sources.excerpt: same dictionary carries a definition of “multilateralism” which is often forgotten in the political discourse, but is a basis of the modern international trade and financial system: “freedom of international trade and currency transfers so as to achieve for each country a trading balance with the total trading area but not necessarily with any one particular country”.
